Proof (general principle of convergence for complex sequences)

Proof (limit of complex sequence separates into real and imaginary parts) open_in_new

The key fact we will use is for all $w\in\C$, $$\max\set{|\Re w|, |\Im w|} \leq |w| \leq |\Re w|+|\Im w|.$$

It follows that $(z_n)$ is Cauchy iff $(\Re z_n)$ and $(\Im z_n)$ are both Cauchy.
